$comment: Copy to specs/<section>.spec.json. This file IS the definition of 'matches Figma'.
Write it during extraction, from what the Figma MCP returns — not afterwards from
what the build happens to render. A spec written to match the build proves nothing.
$comment_assert: From get_variable_defs. Prefer 'token' over 'equals' — it stays correct when a token changes.
$comment_motion: From get_motion_context. Never invent a duration or easing.
$comment_noOverlap: Groups of in-flow siblings that must never intersect at any breakpoint.
$comment_jitter: Elements to watch for scroll feedback loops. Add any sticky/fixed child.
